items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You don't remember, say, Ed Allen's Golden Leaf orchestra? [INTERVIEWEE] Well we had a man by the name of Allen from Algears who played on the Capitol... Red Allen. Red Allen was a player.

ctx.x: Not too well. They were orchestras that would just come for the summer months for four or five months in the summertime. And they would only operate for the summer months. I don't remember that.
You don't remember, say, Ed Allen's Golden Leaf orchestra?

Well we had a man by the name of Allen from Algears who played on the Capitol. They were on New York. He played on the Capitol every once. He was a player. Red Allen. Red Allen was a player. He played in the Big Marbles band. Red Allen.
